metric_definitions.exact_claim: All of player ID, event type, evidential status and availability match one labelled claim; additional emitted claims count against precision.
metric_definitions.exact_evidence_span: The saved quote equals the exact original Unicode slice at the saved start/end offsets.
metric_definitions.wire_agreement: Exactly one complete provider display/subject name matches a trusted roster name/alias after case, punctuation and diacritic normalization; exactly one grounded claim has that ID and agrees with the structured provider's event, status and availability.

real_wire.scope: AI extraction from machine-normalized public provider fields, using an independently collected club roster. Agreement measures name and label consistency. Rumour truth, arbitrary news prose and match accuracy were not evaluated here.
